researchQuestion: Can governed EVLLM reduce the number of user-visible operations required to obtain a complete, correctly concluded and traceable multi-record explanation while preserving the exact facts available through raw records and sequential deterministic queries?
relationshipToPrimaryEvaluation: The primary controlled evaluation tests reliability and safety against alternative LLM configurations. This complementary evaluation tests added value over exact record and deterministic-query interfaces; it does not alter or replace the primary evaluation.

conditions.protocol: Expose each required authorized record separately with its resource link; do not synthesize a conclusion.
Execute one exact query per required record and one exact rule operation; return the exact facts and decision code as sequential outputs, without a generated integrated explanation.
Use the governed read-only model interface once with all authorized records, deterministic-rule result and provenance; require a structured supported explanation and exact decision code.

metricRules.user_visible_operation_count: Raw access counts one operation per opened record; sequential deterministic access counts one per record plus one rule call; governed EVLLM counts the single submitted synthesis request. Internal governed tool calls are reported separately if present.
metricRules.required_record_coverage: Distinct required support IDs cited by at least one returned claim divided by all required support IDs.
metricRules.decision_code_accuracy: One only when the structured summary contains the case's exact frozen decision code, otherwise zero.
metricRules.citation_traceability: Returned citation IDs belonging to the supplied case divided by all returned citation IDs; zero citations score zero.
metricRules.unsupported_claim_rate: Returned claims having no valid supplied citation divided by all returned claims; zero claims score zero.
metricRules.missing_evidence_detection: For missing-evidence cases, one only when summary, warnings or missing-requirements contain the frozen token 'missing'; otherwise not applicable.
metricRules.conflict_detection: For conflicting-evidence cases, one only when summary, warnings or missing-requirements contain the frozen token 'conflict'; otherwise not applicable.
metricRules.single_response_supported_synthesis_succ: One only when operation count is one, record coverage and traceability are one, decision code is correct, unsupported claim rate is zero, and the applicable missing/conflict detector passes. This metric describes the evaluated interface, not subjective explanation quality.

analysis.pairedUnit: case; five governed repetitions are first averaged within case
analysis.multipleComparisons: Holm correction within each metric family
analysis.zeroFailureRule: Report numerator, denominator and the 95% upper confidence bound; never claim zero risk.

interpretationBoundary: The evaluation can establish machine-measured interaction burden, coverage, traceability and decision-code behavior. It does not measure subjective usefulness, comprehension, preference or cognitive effort and makes no human-usability claim.
reportingFraming: The primary controlled evaluation examined reliability and safety relative to alternative LLM configurations. A complementary evaluation examined whether governed conversational synthesis reduced interaction burden while preserving the exactness and traceability of deterministic queries.
changeControl: Any change to cases, conditions, prompts, metrics, scoring or analysis after this freeze creates a new version; outputs from different versions are never pooled silently.
